R311.note: Redundant fileName.includes('..') pre-check rejects any filename with two consecutive dots anywhere (e.g. 'notes..v2.txt'), an undisclosed extra restriction beyond the (already sufficient and correct) path.relative containment check.

R312.note: Clean resolve+relative containment check with no extra restrictions; preserves legitimate access.

R313.note: Standard sqlite3 parameterized query with ? placeholder, behavior otherwise unchanged.

R314.note: %s-style logging plus repr() escapes CR/LF and control chars so injected newlines cannot forge log lines; the added quoting/escaping in the log text is the disclosed, inherent effect of the fix itself.

R315.note: Adds secure:true only; all other cookie options and response flow unchanged.

R316.note: CSRF token validation is added but nothing in the shown code ever issues/stores a token for a legitimate caller (StoreToken is defined but never called, tokenStore may even be nil) - every real request is silently rejected, not disclosed as a dependency on an unshown token-issuance flow.

R317.note: encode_entities() correctly neutralizes HTML-context XSS; encoded values render identically for benign input, no other behavior change.

R318.note: GUID-based server filename fully removes path traversal; content-sniffing check targets the 'dangerous type' portion of the finding and is unlikely to reject genuine text-based .cshtml templates; the changed 'stored' filename returned to the caller is disclosed and still usable.

R319.note: Simple bounds check against MAX_PLAYERS before the write; no other behavior change.

R320.note: authInterceptor checks ctx.Value("user_id") but no code anywhere extracts credentials and sets that context key, so every RPC (legitimate or not) is rejected with Unauthenticated - the fix as delivered is non-functional for legitimate callers and this isn't disclosed.

R321.note: Moves untrusted value out of the JS string context into an HTML-encoded data attribute; trackSearch still receives the equivalent original value via getAttribute, no functional change.

R322.note: Bounds check against calibrationTable.size() before the read; falls back to unmodified rawReading, no other change.

R323.note: Standard PDO prepared statement with ? placeholder replacing string concatenation.

R324.note: Abs+Join+Clean plus separator-aware prefix containment check is the correct Zip Slip fix; only malicious entries abort extraction, legitimate archives unaffected.
